verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own CLI can list models in the gallery (`local-ai models list`) and pull and run models directly from Hugging Face or Ollama URIs via `local-ai run`. That covers browsing and downloading from the command line, but nothing shows keyword search or ongoing management such as removing or updating models. Missing for 10: CLI search/filter of models, CLI model removal/update/management commands, in-depth CLI docs and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface

citations.quote: local-ai models list          # List available models in the gallery
PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
